fusions.name: End Over End
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet at a target up to 5 tiles away. It deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at maximum range, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Felling Revolution
fusions.desc: Swings the axe in a full circle that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and ignores their armour.

fusions.name: Whirling Guard
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Whetted in Motion
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour, and your other abilities come round 5% sooner.
